name: pawagents
description: Delegate one bounded task to an independent read-only subagent running on another model or provider, and get back structured, evidence-backed findings.

interface.shortDescription: Independent read-only subagents on other models
interface.longDescription: PawAgents runs a bounded task in an independent, read-only subagent that uses a different model, a different provider, or a fully local model. Ask it for an independent review, a second opinion on a design, or a cross-check of your own findings, and it returns a structured result with file and line references, evidence and confidence. It never writes to the workspace and never runs a shell command; the calling agent stays responsible for applying changes.
defaultPrompt: Ask PawAgents to independently review my current changes
Have another model look at this bug
Cross-check your review with a second model
